long_condition: IVcurrent < RVcurrent and (abs(IVpred-RVpred)<=0.005 or IVpred rises toward RVpred)
short_condition: IVcurrent > RVcurrent and (abs(IVpred-RVpred)<=0.005 or IVpred falls toward RVpred)
